learning_objective: 🎯 Unlock your inner choreographer and explore how to use your unique body movements to express your own personal feelings!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A choreographer is an artist who invents dance routines. You do not have to copy anyone else because you have the power to mix different steps and invent a dance that is one hundred percent your own!

Dance is a fantastic way to let your emotions out. If you are feeling energetic, your dance might have huge, high jumps, but if you are feeling calm, your movements might flow smoothly like a gentle river.
When you dance, the empty space around you is your blank canvas. You can stretch your arms wide, crouch down super low to the floor, or reach up high to the sky to make your dance visually exciting.

fun_activity.title: 🫧 The Floating Bubble Dance
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are trapped inside a giant, delicate soap bubble. Move your arms, legs, and whole body as smoothly and gently as possible so you do not pop your imaginary bubble!

quick_recap: ⭐ Anyone can be a choreographer by combining different movements to tell their own unique story.
⭐ Using different levels of space, like reaching high or bending low, makes your dance super creative and fun.
